name: Mars surface stay
evacuation: None. Earth is months away, so the crew must treat every problem onboard.

healthFocus.title: Adapting to Mars gravity
healthFocus.detail: After months of weightlessness, standing up can make you dizzy. Stand up slowly and report fainting or near-fainting.

healthFocus.title: Radiation on the surface
healthFocus.detail: The thin air blocks only part of the radiation. Follow the dose plan and use the shelter during solar storms.

healthFocus.title: A longer day (sol)
healthFocus.detail: A sol is 39 minutes longer than an Earth day, which can disturb your body clock. Keep regular light and sleep times.

healthFocus.title: Isolation and long delays
healthFocus.detail: Messages to Earth take up to 22 minutes each way. Look after sleep, mood and team relations.
